title: deguelia angulata
intro: Deguelia angulata, commonly known as African Dogwood, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, malaria, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Deguelia angulata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds work together to provide relief from various health conditions, making Deguelia angulata a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
